name: Volumetric Occlusion Culling via Occlusion Queries
definition: A visibility detection method using GPU occlusion queries to determine if a voxel block is visible (not fully occluded by closer voxels) by rasterizing its bounding box and checking for fragment depth test passes.
summary: Volumetric Occlusion Culling via Occlusion Queries determines voxel block visibility by rasterizing bounding boxes against an opacity-aware depth buffer, distinguishing it from standard binary culling by incorporating accumulated opacity.
